guides.title: Dynamic Guide Page
guides.p1: This dynamic guide route is designed to validate i18n loading for parameterized pages with larger translation payloads.
guides.p2: In production-like scenarios, guide pages often include long explanatory blocks, contextual hints, and onboarding copy.
guides.p3: The fixture intentionally keeps several medium-sized paragraphs to surface extraction and merge edge-cases sooner.
guides.p4: Use different slugs to verify that route params and localized content coexist without affecting translation key resolution.
